name: ai-detect
description: Local AI-text detection: per-sentence and document scores from open detectors, on your own machine.
long_description: Scores text, files and web pages for AI authorship with open detector models that run on this computer. Nothing is uploaded. Models download from Hugging Face on first use (126 MB to 1.7 GB each). Includes a local dashboard.

tools.name: detect_ai_text
tools.description: Score text for AI authorship, per sentence and as a document

tools.name: detect_ai_file
tools.description: Score a local text, Markdown or HTML file

tools.name: detect_ai_url
tools.description: Fetch one web page and score its article text

tools.name: compare_texts
tools.description: Score two texts and report the change

tools.name: scan_batch
tools.description: Scan many files or URLs and return a summary table

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: Available models with licence, size and RAID rank

tools.name: prefetch
tools.description: Download a model ahead of first use
